The InforBio platform offers a series of **online** mini-talks (maximum 30 minutes) on tools and best practices in bioinformatics and biostatistics.

These mini-talks take place on **Tuesday mornings at 9:30 a.m**.

We'd love for you to join us, learn and share together, and grow with the community!


### Season 2026

The new season of mini-talks will start in September 2026, co-organized by 3 Sorbonne University bioinformatics platforms: [InforBio](https://inforbio.github.io/)(IBPS), [ABiMS](https://abims.sb-roscoff.fr) (Roscoff) and [CAIBI](https://crcordeliers.fr/caibi/) (CRC).

#### Autumn program

- 08/09: The IFB tools (@Naïra Naouar, InforBio)
- 15/09: Project Management (@Ivain Raslain, InforBio)
- 29/09: Coding with AI (@Clarice Greoneveld, CAIBI)
- 06/10: Git for Beginners (@Charlotte Berthelier, ABiMS)
- 13/10: Statistic Decision Tree (@Lorette Noiret, InforBio)
